data.long_meaning: The name Clarence is derived from the Latin word 'clarus', meaning clear or bright. in_english.name: Clarence
in_english.meaning: Bright, clear, or illustrious; a name symbolizing spiritual clarity
in_english.long_meaning: The name Clarence is derived from the Latin 'clarus,' meaning clear or bright. It entered the English-speaking world through the Norman Conquest and became popular in the Middle Ages. The name is associated with virtues such as clarity of thought, moral purity, and spiritual enlightenment. Historically, it was borne by several saints and nobles, adding to its prestige and religious significance within Christian tradition.

data.cultural_impact: The name Clarence has been used in various fields throughout history. Notable figures with this name include Clarence Thomas, who was the second African American to be appointment to the US Supreme Court, and Clarence Darnell, an American singer and dancer who was a pioneer in the genre of scat singing. The name also appeared in popular culture through characters such as Uncle Clarence in the animated series "The Proud Family" and Clarence Odbody in Frank Capra's "It's a Wonderful Life".
data.spiritual_significance: In the Christian tradition, the name Clarence holds a deep spiritual significance as it is associated with clarity, understanding, and revelation. The name reminds us of the importance of seeking truth and wisdom in our lives, as well as the role of spiritual guidance in helping us navigate through the complexities of life. This name is a reminder that even in the darkest of times, clarity and understanding can be found when we open ourselves up to the guidance of God and the teachings of the Bible.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Clarence derives from the Old English words "clare" meaning clear and "leah" meaning meadow or clearing. It symbolizes a clear and pure spirit, like a beacon shining in a peaceful and tranquil place. This name embodies the idea of a clear mind and a clear path towards spiritual growth.
